_comment: Prompts for tool/generate_character.dart: one Lottie animation each, made from the character in branding/icon_foreground.png. The game turns the character to face its way, so every animation shows it from one view, facing up the screen, centred, looping smoothly.

animations.idle: The character: a coral-orange (#FF7A59) teardrop-shaped body with a small pointed tip on top, two big round white eyes with dark pupils looking up, a round light-pink belly patch in the lower middle (not a mouth; it has no mouth), a small gold star near the top right, and a soft grey oval shadow underneath. Keep exactly these shapes and colours. No background box, no frame, transparent background. Animation: gentle idle breathing, the body softly squashes and stretches about 5 percent, the eyes blink once, the star twinkles. Smooth seamless loop.
animations.walk: The same round coral character hopping forward in place: it squashes down, stretches up as it bounces, and lands, two bounces per loop. Stays centred, transparent background.
animations.bump: The same round coral character bumps into something: it squashes flat, wobbles left and right, and settles back to round. Stays centred, transparent background.
animations.cheer: The same round coral character celebrates: it jumps up happily, stretches tall, and lands with a bounce, small sparkles around it. Stays centred, transparent background.
